newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syrian, Egyptian presidents talk by phone.
newsitem.headline: Syrian, Egyptian presidents talk by phone.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad and his Egyptian counterpart Hosni Mubarak on Thursday discussed by telephone "some Arab issues", a presidential spokesman said.

He did not give details about the conversation which came one day after Israel and the Palestinian Authority signed a deal that secures a partial Israeli troop withdrawal from the Palestinian West Bank town of Hebron.
Syria has so far made no comment on the agreement. Assad, 66, is recovering from prostate surgery which was announced on January 7.

Israeli-Syrian negotiations, begun in 1991, are frozen over the future of the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in the 1967 Middle East war. Policy guidelines of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing Likud party say Israel must maintain sovereignty over the strategic plateau.
